description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order to impose a Special Levy on Mackerel, Peas, Sugar, etc. valid for a period of 06 months commencing from 08.03.2016
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, imposing and specifying levy rates on various commodities. It contains regulatory measures (rescinding previous orders and imposing new levy rates), which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation rather than announcing a personnel change or detailing portfolio responsibilities, making it primarily a regulatory announcement rather than a government personnel or structural gazette.
